title: Hazel and the Static
author: Gideon Underhill
blurb: Ulyana Vane, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
